desc: Ideation: choose algorithm (Myers/Ukkonen O(K²) furthest-reaching with LCE), enumerate pitfalls
Write the complete first working solution (I/O + prefilters + doubling-slice LCE + Myers diagonal DP)

Reference brute force & correctness cross-check vs Levenshtein semantics on small/edge cases (empty-after-trim, all-equal chars, |S|=|T|, length gap exactly K and K+1); fixed missing monotonicity ("stay") term
Complexity/performance argument: monotone fr ⇒ total snake bytes ≤ (2K+1)·n ≈ 2·10⁷ at C speed; prefix/suffix trim is O(n) — comfortably within limits
Hashing-based LCE fallback deemed unnecessary given the amortization bound
Final polish: exact "Yes"/"No" output, no recursion, single self-contained script
